Travel 2 tiles to forest floor. — Under the canopy — Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.

You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 12 people, 4 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not
